title: Proper direct image preserves ordinary finite-coefficient bounded constructibility over a Noetherian base
statement: Let $f:Y\to S$ be a proper morphism of Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. Use ordinary constant-$A$ module sheaves on small etale sites and their derived direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Then for every $L\in D^b_c(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes], one has $Rf_*L\in D^b_c(S_{\mathrm{et}},A)$. Neither scheme is assumed to have finite Krull dimension. No invertibility condition on $A$ on $S$ is imposed.

source.place: Tag 0GL0, theorem-constructible-shriek, with the identity-open compactification for proper f; boundedness from literature/stacks-project/etale-cohomology.tex, Tag 095U, lemma-cohomological-dimension-proper. This is the proper-finiteness input used in ILO XIII Proposition 3.4.2.
